_meta.title: Science domain graph — connectivity remediation (PROPOSAL ONLY)
_meta.purpose: Grounded feedback/reciprocal edges and redundant paths to remediate the findings from assets/js/energy-connectivity-audit.js (the audit module is domain-generic) run against assets/data/domains/science.json. This is a recommendation artifact; it does NOT modify any live graph.
_meta.discipline: Every proposed edge carries a concrete grounding (a canonical-nodes.json regulatory fact OR the reciprocity of an existing science.json edge). Candidates that could not be grounded are omitted and tallied under _omittedForLackOfGrounding.
_meta.doNotApply: Do not merge these edges into assets/data/domains/science.json without an explicit apply step.
_meta.neuroReferenceThesis: Healthy circuits are ~80% recurrent/lateral; the network, not the node, is the unit of failure (diaschisis). A pure feedforward tree is the broken/cosmetic version.
_meta.pathologyVerdict: SAME AS ENERGY/FINANCE, plus a MORE SEVERE version of Finance's extra fault. Science shows the identical core signature: ZERO reciprocal/feedback edges (recurrentFraction 0) despite carrying directed control rings, and many single points of failure (10 articulation nodes). The EXTRA fault: the graph is fractured into 2 components at baseline (as in Finance), but where Finance's severed piece was a 2-node {M1,SMA} dyad, Science's severed piece is a LARGE 10-node island — the entire thalamo-sensory-relay + basal-ganglia-gating subsystem {THAL, V1, A1, S1, LGN, MGN, GP, STRI, CBLM, FEF} — cut off from the 31-node cognitive/research body. The sensory/relay 'body' of Science is disconnected from its 'mind'.

recurrenceAudit.note: ZERO reciprocal/feedback edges — the same feedforward-only signature the neuro reference calls the broken version. The graph carries directed cycles (the business-layer control ring DMN->dACC->FPN->vmPFC->PRECUNEUS->HYPO->DMN via CONTROLS+DEPENDS_ON edges), but for no edge A->B does B->A exist, so recurrentFraction is exactly 0. Module verdict = 'has recurrent/lateral structure' only because lateralFractionOfClassifiable (0.382) clears the 0.2 lateral threshold; the feedback dimension is fully absent. Of 64 edges, 30 are unknownGroup (one/both endpoints are anatomical scaffold nodes — mPFC, BLA, CeA, PAG, PVN, THAL, V1, etc. — that are not in the activation set).

singlePointsOfFailure.baseComponentsNote: TWO components at baseline. Main body = 31 nodes (the research/cognition cluster: DMN, dlPFC, dACC, FPN, ECN, vmPFC, OFC, NAcc, VTA, VP, HIPP, AG, rACC, BROCA, PRECUNEUS, IPS, TPJ, M1, SMA, HYPO, NTS, WERN, AI, PI, BLA, CeA, PAG, PVN, HPA, LC, mPFC). Island = 10 nodes {A1, CBLM, FEF, GP, LGN, MGN, S1, STRI, THAL, V1} — the thalamo-sensory-relay + basal-ganglia-gating subsystem, with NO edge in or out of the main body. This pre-existing fracture is the extra fault vs Energy (baseComponents=1) and is far larger than Finance's 2-node severed dyad.

mechanismOfEachArticulation.M1: sole attachment of leaf SMA (SMA->M1 is SMA's only edge into the main body)
mechanismOfEachArticulation.HIPP: sole attachment of leaf HPA (HPA->HIPP is HPA's only edge)
mechanismOfEachArticulation.OFC: sole bridge of the mesolimbic reward triad {NAcc, VP, VTA} to the main body — NAcc->OFC is that triad's only link out
mechanismOfEachArticulation.vmPFC: sole attachment of leaf PAG (vmPFC->PAG is PAG's only edge)
mechanismOfEachArticulation.THAL: the ISLAND HUB. Removing it splits the 10-node island into 5 pieces: {FEF, LGN, V1}, {A1, MGN}, {S1}, {GP, STRI}, {CBLM}. THAL is the sole attachment of leaf S1 (THAL->S1 only) and of CBLM (CBLM->THAL only), and the sole hub linking the sensory relays.
mechanismOfEachArticulation.V1: sole attachment of leaves LGN (LGN->V1 only) and FEF (FEF->V1 only)
mechanismOfEachArticulation.A1: sole attachment of leaf MGN (MGN->A1 only)
mechanismOfEachArticulation.AI: sole attachment of leaf PI (PI->AI only)
mechanismOfEachArticulation.NAcc: sole attachment of leaves VTA (VTA->NAcc only) and VP (NAcc->VP only) within the reward triad
mechanismOfEachArticulation.GP: sole attachment of leaf STRI (STRI->GP is STRI's only edge)

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the conflict-monitoring -> cognitive-control loop: the conflict/error signal feeds back to the executive to adjust control gain.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge dlPFC->dACC (excit). canonical-nodes dACC = M6 'conflict/error monitor', dlPFC = 'dorsolateral PFC — executive working-memory / cognitive control'. dACC<->dlPFC are reciprocally connected (Botvinick conflict-control loop).

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the salience-network loop; the two salience hubs must be mutually coupled to co-select what gets escalated.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge AI->dACC (excit, 'interoceptive -> conflict monitor'). canonical-nodes AI = M10 'interoceptive salience'; the anterior insula and dorsal ACC are the two defining hubs of the salience network and are reciprocally coupled by definition.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the value<->context loop; the context/valuation brake feeds back onto outcome valuation. Reciprocal of the existing OFC->vmPFC edge.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge OFC->vmPFC (excit). canonical-nodes vmPFC = M1 'top-down inhibitory brake', OFC = M6 'outcome valuation / update'; they are adjacent medial/orbital PFC regions with dense reciprocal connectivity.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the valuation<->reward loop; the outcome-valuation stage feeds forward-and-back to the reward driver. Reciprocal of the existing NAcc->OFC edge.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge NAcc->OFC (excit). The orbitofrontal cortex is a principal glutamatergic corticostriatal input to the ventral striatum / nucleus accumbens (canonical OFC->NAcc projection). canonical-nodes OFC = M6 valuation, NAcc = M11 'incentive/reward drive'.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Corticothalamic feedback closing the visual thalamo-cortical loop that THAL->V1 opens.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge THAL->V1 (excit, visual sensory relay). V1->LGN/pulvinar corticothalamic feedback is canonical and modulatory (feedback outnumbers feedforward). canonical-nodes THAL = M4 'gating relay / routing', V1 = 'primary visual processing'. NOTE: both endpoints are inside the severed island, so this raises recurrentFraction but does not itself reconnect the island.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Corticothalamic feedback closing the auditory thalamo-cortical loop that THAL->A1 opens.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge THAL->A1 (excit, auditory sensory relay). A1->MGN corticothalamic feedback is canonical and modulatory. Island-internal (recurrence only).

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Corticothalamic feedback closing the somatosensory thalamo-cortical loop that THAL->S1 opens.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge THAL->S1 (excit, somatosensory relay). Layer-6 corticothalamic feedback S1->VPL is one of the most numerous projection classes in the brain, functionally gain/precision control -> modul. Island-internal (recurrence only).

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the executive <-> frontoparietal-control loop: the dorsolateral executive both draws on and drives the fronto-parietal integration network.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge FPN->dlPFC (excit, 'fronto-parietal -> executive'). canonical-nodes FPN = the frontoparietal control network (composite) of which dlPFC is a core hub; the two are reciprocally coupled by construction of the executive-control system.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the amygdala<->prefrontal regulation loop; the threat-appraisal node projects back to the ventromedial brake it is regulated by. Reciprocal of the existing vmPFC->BLA inhibitory edge.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge vmPFC->BLA (inhib, 'context-based threat regulation'). The basolateral amygdala sends a dense glutamatergic projection to the ventromedial/medial PFC (canonical amygdalo-prefrontal projection, the afferent limb of the fear-regulation loop). canonical-nodes BLA = M7 'threat learning/acquisition', vmPFC = M1 top-down brake.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: EXTRA-FAULT FIX. The 10-node thalamo-sensory-relay + basal-ganglia island is fully disconnected at baseline. A corticostriatal edge from a main-body cortical motor node (SMA) into the island's striatal input (STRI) reattaches the island, reducing baseComponents 2->1. Paired with THAL->M1 and THAL->dlPFC below so the island has multiple independent bridges and no single new articulation node is created.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes SMA = 'supplementary motor — self-initiated action sequencing'; SMA is a principal cortical source of the motor corticostriatal projection to putamen/striatum (canonical). STRI = composite basal-ganglia input stage; the in-graph output limb STRI->GP->THAL already exists, so this supplies its missing cortical input limb.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: Second island bridge and the canonical return leg of the cortico-basal-ganglia-thalamo-cortical motor loop whose output limb STRI->GP->THAL is already in-graph. Connects the island hub (THAL) to a main-body motor node (M1).
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes THAL = M4 'gating relay / routing', M1 = 'primary motor cortex — motor output'. The ventral-anterior/ventral-lateral thalamus -> M1 projection is the canonical thalamocortical motor relay and the return leg of the BG loop already half-present in-graph (STRI->GP inhib, GP->THAL inhib).

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: Third, M1-independent island bridge. Without it, both bridges above land on the SMA/M1 motor node, so removing M1 re-severs the island (M1 stays an articulation point). A mediodorsal-thalamus -> dlPFC projection reattaches the island through a second cortical target, dropping M1 from the articulation set.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes THAL = M4 'gating relay / routing', dlPFC = 'dorsolateral PFC — executive working-memory / cognitive control'. The mediodorsal thalamic nucleus -> dorsolateral PFC projection is a canonical thalamocortical projection (the MD-PFC pathway) and the higher-order-relay analog of the sensory thalamocortical edges already in-graph.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: HPA reaches the graph only via HPA->HIPP, so removing HIPP isolates it. Cortisol also acts on the amygdala, giving HPA a second, well-grounded anchor; removing HIPP then leaves HPA attached via BLA.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: Glucocorticoid (HPA-axis) output acts on the basolateral amygdala via glucocorticoid receptors, enhancing threat processing (textbook stress endocrinology). canonical-nodes BLA = M7 'threat learning/acquisition'. NOTE: canonical-nodes marks HPA as a COMPOSITE ('not an edge endpoint'); the cleaner long-run fix is to remap HPA to a view rather than treat it as a node.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: PAG reaches the graph only via vmPFC->PAG, so removing vmPFC isolates it. A central-amygdala -> PAG efferent gives PAG a second afferent; removing vmPFC then leaves PAG attached via CeA. Also closes the threat-appraisal -> defensive-output pathway.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes CeA = M7 'phasic fear output'; PAG = M8 'defensive kill/lockdown'. The central-amygdala -> periaqueductal-gray projection is the textbook fear-output pathway.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: PI reaches the graph only via PI->AI, so removing AI isolates it. A posterior-insula -> cingulate interoceptive edge gives PI a second anchor; removing AI then leaves PI attached via dACC.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes PI = M10 'primary interoception', dACC = M6 conflict monitor / salience hub. Posterior/mid-insula interoceptive signals project to the anterior cingulate as part of the interoception-salience pathway.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: The mesolimbic reward triad {NAcc, VP, VTA} reaches the main body only via NAcc->OFC, so removing OFC isolates the whole triad. A ventromedial-PFC -> accumbens corticostriatal edge gives the triad a second bridge; removing OFC then leaves it attached via vmPFC.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: Ventromedial / medial PFC sends a dense glutamatergic corticostriatal projection to the nucleus accumbens shell (canonical vmPFC->NAcc). canonical-nodes vmPFC = M1 brake, NAcc = M11 'incentive/reward drive'.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: Within the reward triad, VP and VTA hang off NAcc (VTA->NAcc, NAcc->VP), so removing NAcc splits them off. The reward-loop closure edge VP->VTA gives the pair a mutual link and doubles as recurrence: it closes the mesolimbic reward loop VTA->NAcc->VP->VTA (the hedonic-output stage feeds back to regulate the dopamine source).
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: In-graph the reward chain VTA->NAcc (excit) and NAcc->VP (inhib) already exists; the ventral pallidum sends GABAergic feedback to VTA (canonical mesolimbic disinhibition loop). canonical-nodes VP = 'ventral pallidum — reward/hedonic output', VTA = M11 'dopamine reward source'.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: Gives the {VTA, VP} pair a main-body anchor independent of NAcc; with VP->VTA above, removing NAcc then leaves the pair attached to the cortex via VTA->mPFC, dropping NAcc from the articulation set.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes VTA = M11 'dopamine reward source', mPFC = 'medial PFC — self-referential value integration (DMN core)'. The VTA -> mPFC mesocortical dopamine projection is canonical (the mesocortical dopamine pathway).

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: FEF reaches the graph only via FEF->V1, so removing V1 isolates it. A frontal-eye-fields -> thalamus corticothalamic edge gives FEF a second anchor within the island; removing V1 then leaves FEF attached via THAL, dropping FEF from V1's isolate set (leaving only LGN, which cannot be grounded).
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes FEF = 'frontal eye fields — attentional gaze control', THAL = M4 gating relay. The FEF -> mediodorsal/VA thalamus corticothalamic projection is canonical (frontal oculomotor-attention control of the thalamic relay).

projectedImpact.method: The 19 proposed edges (9 feedback + 10 redundant/reconnection) were appended to a deep copy of science.json in memory and re-scored with assets/js/energy-connectivity-audit.js. science.json itself was NOT modified.

reciprocalEdges.note: the 9 reciprocal pairs are exactly the 9 proposedFeedbackEdges (each is the reverse of a pre-existing edge).

lateralFractionOfClassifiable.note: unchanged lateral edge count (13); the small drop is only because the denominator (classifiable edges) grows as reconnection edges add activation-set endpoints.

baseComponents.note: the 10-node thalamo-sensory-relay island is reconnected by SMA->STRI + THAL->M1 + THAL->dlPFC; the graph becomes a single connected body.

articulationNodes.reason: All three residual articulation points survive solely because a dedicated sensory/relay leaf has no second grounded projection target present in the graph, so its redundant path was omitted rather than fabricated: THAL still cuts off S1 and CBLM; V1 still cuts off LGN; A1 still cuts off MGN. This is the SAME honest floor Energy and Finance bottomed out at (THAL/V1/A1 for the identical S1/CBLM/LGN/MGN dedicated-relay reason). The MD-thalamus->dlPFC bridge specifically removes M1 from the set (without it, M1 would remain a residual articulation point because both other island bridges land on the SMA/M1 motor node).

candidates.candidate: redundant path around THAL via a second edge on CBLM
candidates.reason: CBLM reaches the graph only via CBLM->THAL. The thalamus does not project to the cerebellum, and cerebellar cortical input arrives polysynaptically via the pontine nuclei (no direct cortex->CBLM fiber to any in-graph node). No honest second edge, so CBLM stays a leaf of THAL and THAL stays a residual articulation point for it.

candidates.candidate: redundant path around THAL via a second edge on S1
candidates.reason: S1 reaches the graph only via THAL->S1 (and the proposed S1->THAL feedback, which still terminates on THAL). A second grounded S1 target is S1->M1 (dense reciprocal somatomotor connectivity), but it was NOT added: it would not clear THAL from the articulation set while the ungroundable CBLM leaf persists. Recorded under notedButNotOmitted, not as a fabrication.

candidates.candidate: redundant path around V1 via a second edge on LGN
candidates.reason: LGN is a dedicated retino-recipient thalamic relay whose only cortical target is V1; the pulvinar / superior-colliculus partners that would give it a second grounded projection are not present as nodes in the science graph. LGN stays a leaf of V1.

candidates.candidate: redundant path around A1 via a second edge on MGN
candidates.reason: MGN is a dedicated cochlea-recipient (medial geniculate) auditory thalamic relay whose only cortical target is A1; no second grounded projection target exists among the graph's nodes. MGN stays a leaf of A1.

Hippocampal output to lateral PFC is not a monosynaptic projection; direct hippocampal-PFC fibers target mPFC/vmPFC, not dlPFC, and the mPFC relay is not on a science-graph edge path. Cannot ground a direct HIPP->dlPFC edge (identical omission to Finance).

_omittedForLackOfGrounding.notedButNotOmitted: S1->M1 (dense reciprocal somatomotor connectivity) IS groundable once M1 is reconnected to the main body, but it was NOT added because it would not clear THAL from the articulation set while the ungroundable CBLM leaf persists. It is recorded here as a groundable future edge, not an omission for lack of grounding.
